economic_rationale: Across broad equity, gold, and bond ETFs, relative return leadership persists over medium horizons as capital rotates between risk-on and defensive assets; ranking a fixed qualified ETF set by trailing return and holding only the top performer captures that rotation, while an optional positive absolute-trend gate avoids entering a momentum leader that is itself falling. The counterparty view is that 6/12-month momentum whipsaws at turning points and the gate adds lag; the fixed OOS interval will decide.
rule_pseudocode: On the last open session of month M: for each universe ETF with >= N known closes: r = close_T / close_(T-N+1) - 1; rank by (-r, InstrumentId); top1 = first; if trend_gate declared and len(top1 closes) < G: NO_DECISION(INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY); if gate declared and close_T(top1) <= sma_G(top1): TARGETS top1 weight 0.0 plus every held instrument weight 0.0 (cash exit); else TARGETS top1 weight 1.0 plus every held non-top1 instrument weight 0.0.
parameter_rationale: Predeclared priority, not return-optimized: plain 6-month momentum first, 12-month second, and the gated 6-month variant last, because the gate adds lag and is an economic fallback rather than a preferred configuration. No grid search beyond the three M1-D02 combinations.

universe_policy.formation_rule: Fixed frozen view of the M0-qualified M1 first-batch ETF set (broad-based equity, ChiNext broad equity, gold, bond) for the whole run; no reconstitution, no future membership backfill, no cross-border/QDII or money-market ETF.

benchmark.rationale: Inception equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same frozen universe through the same M0 kernel isolates the rotation decision from asset exposure; benchmark is pre-registered before any result.

risk_off_rationale: M1-D04: when the trend gate fails, the strategy exits to zero-yield CASH_0; it never silently substitutes a defensive ETF for cash, and gold/bond remain rankable positions like any other instrument.
basic_promotion_rationale: Fail-closed pre-registered gate: full-window NAV coverage, total return within 5pp of the universe equal-weight buy-and-hold, maximum drawdown no deeper than -40%, and cumulative half-gross turnover at most 12x average equity (rotation is expected to trade more than trend). No threshold is tuned after results are seen.
oos_survivor_rationale: Survivor means 'worth M2 robustness validation', not tradability: same benchmark-relative return floor and drawdown ceiling as Basic, applied to the fixed OOS interval only.
known_limitations: Monthly cadence misses intra-month reversals; momentum whipsaws near turns are expected.
A ChiNext broad-equity ETF and a bond ETF are ranked together; their very different risk profiles are intentional (the benchmark carries the same mix).
CASH_0 ignores any money-market yield; the comparison is conservative for carry.
Basic snapshot physically ends at 2022-12-30; the fixed OOS request 2023-01-03..2025-12-31 stays unrevealed until after freeze.
source: M1 protocol section 7.2 owner-approved seed candidate; no external code or text copied.
